label: Basic
description: Basic context menu. Best for the bare minimum of 3 plain rows opened by a long press, with the middle row disabled.

label: Icons
description: Context menu with icons. Best for clipboard commands, Copy, Cut and Paste, each with a leading icon, and a destructive Delete in its own group.

label: Shortcuts
description: Context menu with keyboard shortcuts. Best for navigation and save commands with key caps on each row and Forward disabled.

label: Nested Submenus
description: Context menu with a submenu. Best for a More tools submenu of 3 groups, Delete last, below 2 clipboard rows with key caps.

label: Labels & Separators
description: Context menu headings and groups. Best for 4 groups, File and Edit headed, with key caps on every row down to a destructive Delete.

label: Checkbox Items
description: Context menu with checkbox items. Best for 3 browser view toggles that show a tick when on, 2 of them on at load.

label: Radio Items
description: Context menu with radio items. Best for a person picker and a Light, Dark or System theme switch, each a headed radio set held in state.

label: Destructive Actions
description: Context menu with destructive actions. Best for Edit and Share, then Archive and a destructive Delete, every row led by an icon.

label: Alignment Sides
description: Context menus on several areas. Best for 4 tiles that each open their own menu, named for the tile, on a long press.

label: Inside Dialog
description: Context menu inside a dialog. Best for a long press area inside a dialog, with icon rows, a More options submenu and a destructive Delete.
